$comment: campaigns/<c>/dm/shops/<slug>.json: one shop. The DM decides what it stocks (fitting the settlement: library/pf1e/rules/equipment-economy.md, base value); scripts/gear.py sells from the stock at its prices and buys what it deals in, up to the settlement's purchase limit per item.

name.description: as the players know it: 'Ossa Fennick's smithy'

purchase_limit.description: the most it pays for any single item the party sells, in gp (the settlement's purchase limit)

buys.description: item categories it buys from the party (default: the categories it stocks)

markup.description: price factor when the party buys (default 1: list price)

qty.description: pieces in stock; null or missing = as many as wanted

price.description: this shop's price per piece in gp, if it isn't the list price

notes.description: DM notes: who runs it, haggling, what it's out of
